title: Typed-only DWG ModelDocViewStyle same-version DXF serialization
summary: Allow a bounded typed-only DWG-origin DetailViewStyle/SectionViewStyle graph to serialize to same-version DXF when its validated NOD child dictionaries and resource references are already present. DXF-origin raw replay remains unchanged.

behavior.supportedProfile: A successful, single-version DWG style capture with complete typed style values, validated NOD-to-named-child dictionary ownership, closed resource references, and no unrepresented common-object payload.
behavior.output: Reuse the existing raw overlay/writer path with synthetic style shells for the recognized DWG profile; preserve the target DWG revision and ASCII/Binary DXF encoding.
behavior.dictionaryGraph: The route consumes the already-validated NOD-to-named-child dictionary graph; it does not synthesize or repair missing/ambiguous child dictionaries.
failClosed: Missing, duplicate, or wrong-owner style dictionary membership
Unrepresented reactors, extension-dictionary metadata, XDATA/appdata, AcDs payload, or pending references
Capture receipt that is not a single successful DWG-origin style import
behavior.compatibility: Existing DXF raw-carrier replay remains available only under its prior source/target revision and carrier checks; no DRW_Interface pure virtual was added.

tests.provenanceLimit: The test starts with the existing generated DXF callback graph, changes its import envelope to a successful DWG-origin capture, clears the raw style carriers, then tests the typed writer route. This is not a DWG-reader or producer qualification.
coverage: DetailViewStyle and SectionViewStyle names and typed non-handle fields survive export and DXF re-import
Dictionary-derived style naming and NOD child dictionary graph are retained
Resource-reference closure resolves to the expected text styles, line type, and block record
Raw style carriers are generated on DXF readback
A neighboring POINT survives the OBJECTS output path
Cross-version export is refused while preserving a pre-existing destination
Wrong style dictionary owner is refused while preserving a pre-existing destination

validation.scopedDiffCheck: git diff --check passed for changed tracked source, tests, and plan; added receipt checked separately

scope.commitBlocker: Workspace Git metadata is read-only; changes remain unstaged and uncommitted.
